entities.summary: Joshua Leivo is a Canadian professional ice hockey player who is a winger for Traktor Chelyabinsk of the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). He had previously played in the National Hockey League (NHL) within the Toronto Maple Leafs, Vancouver Canucks, Calgary Flames, Carolina Hurricanes and St. Louis Blues organizations.
